title: Oh, Lord You are my Shepherd
lyrics: Verse 1:
Oh, [Cm]Lord You are my Sh[Fm]epherd
I will n[B]ot lack for an[Eb]ything,
You m[Ab]ake me lie in p[Fm]astures green
You l[G]ead me by the quiet streams!
Chorus 1:
Wh[Cm]erever I go, I will n[Fm]ot fear,
Wh[B]oever I'm with You're b[Eb]y my side!
W[Ab]herever I go, I will n[Fm]ot fear,
Your r[G]od and your staff they comfort my soul!
Verse 2:
Lord Jesus You're my Shepherd,
I will not lack for anything!
You make me lie in pastures green
Your water nourishes me!
Verse 3:
Oh, Lord You are my heart's desire,
You are my life, my happiness,
I'm filled with You, I abide in You,
Your grace surrounds my life!
